topics.purpose: Define deterministic bundle of scan, validation, registry, reconciliation, readiness, conformance and projection reports for one run/snapshot.

semantics.snapshot_rule: All member reports must refer to same compatible source/bootstrap snapshot or explicit derivation chain.
semantics.format_rule: Bundle may be zip/directory manifest projection.
semantics.authority_rule: Bundle does not become canonical source.

invariants.rule: Toolchain code, scans, indexes, reports and generated artifacts remain implementation/evidence surfaces; they never become canonical semantic authority unless an explicit accepted canonical definition says so.
Every toolchain execution binds exact bootstrap/source/profile/input revisions and must not resolve ambiguity through filesystem order, newest-wins, mtime, fuzzy names or UI layout.

hard_gates.condition: latest report per type picked by mtime
missing report ignored despite required profile
